Name: Mushroom Rancher In Slime Hutch
Author: Goldenrevolver
Description:
[size=3][color=#6aa84f]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.7 and SMAPI 4.0.8. Source available on Github:[/color]
[url=https://github.com/Goldenrevolver/Stardew-Valley-Mods]https://github.com/Goldenrevolver/Stardew-Valley-Mods
[/url]

Allows you to raise and herd living mushrooms (normal or magma caps) in the slime hutch and changes its interior based on which monster you have the most of in that hutch (including a slimy version for slimes).

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/10978/10978-1644374403-2120304835.png[/img]

This mod exists for two reasons:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Firstly, I wanted a Foraging based "farm animal" that isn't the pig (sorry, pigs)[/size]
[*][size=3]Secondly, those mushrooms are simply too cute[/size]
[/list][size=3]

[b][u]1.1. Living Mushrooms:

[/u][/b]These friendly fungi are always full of energy and ready to jump at you playfully. Throw a Red Mushroom onto a Mushroom Incubator (see below) to get them.

Similar to Slimes and Slime Balls, they will produce one Purple Mushroom for every 2.5 Living Mushrooms in the hutch, so a full hutch of 20 produces 8 Purple Mushrooms every day (works with Botanist).

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/10978/10978-1644384297-902302129.png[/img]
(they are technically [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Dust_Sprite_(dangerous)]Dangerous Dust Sprites[/url], so any texture mods apply to them)


[b][u]1.2. False Magma Caps:[/u][/b]

These shy shrooms lay dormant for most of the day, but when you get near them to figure out if they are a real Magma Cap or not, they will happily approach you. Throw a Magma Cap onto a Mushroom Incubator (see below) to get them.

Similar to Slimes and Slime Balls, they will produce one Magma Cap for every 2.5 False Magma Caps in the hutch, so a full hutch of 20 produces 8 Magma Caps every day (works with Botanist).

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/10978/10978-1644384307-1647997401.png[/img]


[b][u]1.3. Mushroom Incubator:

[/u][/b]This is the equivalent to the Slime Incubator. They are unlocked at Foraging Level 6 and have the same crafting recipe as a cask. You need one mushroom and 5 [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Life_Elixir]Life Elixir[/url] to start incubation, which then takes 2 days (1 with the coopmaster perk). [b]They will only create live mushroom monsters inside the slime hutch!

([/b]They currently use slightly altered old sprites from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4637]Mushroom Propagator[/url] with permission. If you'd like to make a custom sprite, please let me know)

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/10978/10978-1644384281-2096562689.gif[/img]


[b][u]2.1. Dynamic Natural Hutch Interior:[/u][/b]

Your hutch won't stay a clean brick prison for long with monsters living inside it. The hutch interior will change depending on which monster you have the most of in that hutch. This change is per hutch, so different hutches can have different interior designs. Alternatively, you can simply set every hutch to any of the designs or turn the feature off completely in the config.

For the exterior, you can use the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12635]Mushroom Slime Hutch for Alternative Textures (AT)[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/11157158]Lydocia[/url] to change the textures of specific hutches via AT. There are plans to integrate these sprites into this mod so it happens automatically. Thank you so much, Lydocia, for making the mod and giving me permission to integrate it in the future.﻿

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/10978/10978-1644384259-595367520.gif[/img]


[b][u]2.2. Randomize Monster Position In Hutch:[/u][/b]

This simply randomizes every monster position inside the hutch daily, so they don't all stay stuck in the top left corner. In my opinion this is needed because the new mushroom monsters don't have a lot idle movement (or any for the False Magma Cap), so they stay bunched up where they spawn, but you can turn it off in the config if you don't like it. As many people fence off their slimes, by default it does not affect them.[/size]
[size=3]

Requirements:
[url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]: I built version 1.2.2 of this mod based on version 4.0.8. It should be compatible with a few future versions. You can get the latest version of SMAPI [url=https://smapi.io/]here[/url].


Installation:
Install SMAPI. Then extract the content of the downloaded zip file into the SMAPI mods folder and start the game via the SMAPI launcher or Steam if you have set the launch option for SMAPI in Steam. The config file will be generated inside the folder of the mod. Close the game to edit it and restart the game.

You can also optionally use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to change the config ingame (only on the title screen) without the need to close and restart (otherwise you need to restart) but it is not required to be installed.


Updating: 
Simply delete the prior version (both folders) and install the new one.


Uninstallation:
You can delete this mod from your mods folder (both folders) at any time to remove the features. It's recommended to kill the living mushrooms before doing so, because they will look weird.[/size]

Downloads.Description: Added the new base game 'OnlyCompleteOvernight' flag to the mushroom incubator which was added to the base game specifically to make incubators more reliable (so they don't 'complete' in the middle of the day if you have a custom duration)
